text:
Morgan (CEO): Quick thread from today's all-hands Q&A  let's capture the concrete asks about recent wins/losses and who owns follow-ups. Keep replies short.
Priya (CS): Top three customer blockers from support calls: compliance proof, long POC setup, and surprise cost spikes on burst traffic. Customers ask for a downloadable kit.
Noor (Sales): Field note: lost two banking deals due to residency + audit needs; one churn signal from a retail customer because latency spiked during promos. Wins call out a hands-on POC engineer + a short runbook.
Diego (Product): Small set of deliverables I can own: 1) POC runbook template with success metrics (ETA 5d), 2) Dedicated vs Private one-pager (ETA 7d), 3) AE collection checklist (ETA 4d).
Jonas (Eng): Engineering quick wins: enable prefix KV caching for POCs by default, tweak batching to a lower latency profile for POC clusters, and publish a "latency tuning" snippet. I'll draft configs and microbenchmarks.
Hazel (Analytics): I'll build a tiny win/loss schema and dashboard: fields = deal_id, reason_tag, p50_latency, mrr, time_to_poc. Will use it to measure impact after artifacts land.
Priya (CS): Action: I'll compile anonymized loss notes + common asks and produce a customer kit skeleton. Owner: Priya + Noor. ETA 10 business days.
Noor (Sales): I'll upload sanitized loss notes to #sales-docs and tag the top accounts for outreach.
Diego (Product): Action: I'll post the first-pass POC runbook to the issue and include an AE checklist. Please review when posted.
Jonas (Eng): Quick note: small batching + cache changes reduced median latency ~12% on our promo traces. Will attach numbers.
ci-bot: Created issue #CI-4298: "all-hands: customer kit + POC runbook + latency playbook" (https://github.com/redwood-inference/internal/issues/4298)
Morgan (CEO): Prioritize the compliance/artifact pack first. If legal/residency is a blocker, connectors are less likely to matter. Link owners & due dates to the GitHub issue.
Priya (CS): Scheduling a 30-min sync next Thu 9am PT to review drafts. Invite to @here.
Noor (Sales): Ack  will add the anonymized notes and highlight the two bank losses.
Hazel (Analytics): Will wire the dashboard up to the issue so we can track pre/post changes.
Diego (Product): Thanks — if anyone has quick snippets (<2h) like network diagrams or Terraform samples, drop them in the issue so AEs can use immediately.
